samples.xml_description:
<module id="clkgenerator">
    <description>A clock generator that generates a periodic clock signal based on the given period.</description>
    <ports>
        <output id="clk">The generated clock signal.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <param id="PERIOD">The period for generating the clock signal.</param>
    </parameter_description>
    
    <implementation>The module uses an initial block to initialize the clock signal and then toggles it at regular intervals based on the period.</implementation>
    
    <task id="initialize_clock">
        <description>Initializes the clock signal to 0.</description>
        <code>clk <= 0;</code>
    </task>
    <task id="toggle_clock">
        <description>Toggles the clock signal after half of the period.</description>
        <code>clk <= ~clk;</code>
    </task>
    
    <initial>
        <call_task task_id="initialize_clock"></call_task>
        
        // Loop to toggle the clock signal at regular intervals based on the period
        <for_loop start_value="0" end_value="PERIOD / 2 - 1">
            <call_task task_id="wait_for_half_period"></call_task>
            
            <call_task task_id="toggle_clock"></call_task>
        </for_loop>
    </initial>
    
    <task id="wait_for_half_period">
        <description>Waits for half of the period before toggling the clock signal.</description>
        <code>/* Wait for half of the period */</code>
    </task>
</module>
